hero.label: Platform Capabilities
hero.title: Platform Capabilities
hero.subtitle: FinFlow is a full financial operating system built on microservices architecture. Not just budgeting — complete control over accounting, automation, and analytics.

core.label: Financial Core
core.title: Accounting & Financial Management
core.description: Core accounting subsystem: accounts, transactions, currencies, and categories. Built on isolated services with dedicated databases.

accounts.title: Accounts & Balances
accounts.desc: Bank, cash, crypto, and investment accounts. Automatic balance tracking on every operation.

transactions.title: Expenses & Income
transactions.desc: Full transaction ledger linked to accounts, categories, and currencies. Filter by period, type, and amount.

currency.title: Multi-Currency Engine
currency.desc: Support for any currency with real-time conversion rates. Automatic recalculation on cross-account transfers.

categories.title: Category System
categories.desc: Hierarchical categories with MCC code support. Automatic category recognition on bank statement imports.

automation.label: Automation
automation.title: Automation You Don't Have to Think About
automation.description: Internal background processes and microservices handle routine operations without your involvement.

recurring.title: Recurring Transactions
recurring.desc: Set up daily, weekly, or monthly payments. Transactions are created automatically on schedule.

scheduler.title: Built-in Scheduler
scheduler.desc: APScheduler-based background processes for zero-delay task execution. Retry logic and logging for every operation.

subscriptions.title: Subscription Lifecycle
subscriptions.desc: Automatic renewal, suspension, and cancellation of subscriptions. Limit enforcement based on selected plan.

balance.title: Auto Balance Updates
balance.desc: Account balances recalculate automatically after every transaction, including recurring and imported operations.

workspace.label: Workspaces
workspace.title: Isolated Workspaces
workspace.description: Every user operates in an isolated workspace. Create shared spaces for family or team with full access control.

personal.title: Personal Workspace
personal.desc: Created automatically on registration. Full data isolation at database level — no other user has access.

shared.title: Shared Workspaces
shared.desc: Create spaces for shared accounting. Suitable for family budgets, business expenses, or team projects.

roles.title: Role-Based Access
roles.desc: Three access levels: owner, full access, and read-only. Flexible permission management.

invites.title: Invite System
invites.desc: Invite members by email. Each invitation has an expiry and can be revoked by the workspace owner.

isolation.title: Multi-Tenant Isolation
isolation.desc: Each workspace's data is fully isolated. Queries are filtered at ORM level — cross-workspace leaks are impossible.

intelligence.label: Analytics & Control
intelligence.title: Financial Control, Not Just Tracking
intelligence.description: Tools for strategic financial management: goals, debts, progress monitoring, and bank data import.

goals.title: Financial Goals
goals.desc: Set goals with milestones and deadlines. Automatic progress tracking and remaining amount calculation.

debts.title: Debt Tracking
debts.desc: Loans, mortgages, personal debts. Principal and interest breakdown with payment schedule tracking.

progress.title: Progress Monitoring
progress.desc: Financial metrics visualization over time. Period comparison, expense and income trends.

pdf.title: PDF Statement Import
pdf.desc: Upload a Monobank PDF statement — transactions are recognized, parsed, and categorized automatically via a dedicated microservice.

platform.label: SaaS Platform
platform.title: Built as a Real SaaS
platform.description: Not a side project — a full platform with subscriptions, limits, payments, and background renewal.

plans.title: Subscription Plans
plans.desc: Three subscription tiers with different feature sets and limits. Flexible scaling to match your needs.

entitlements.title: Feature Entitlements
entitlements.desc: Feature access is controlled at plan level. Limit checks happen in real time on every operation.

payments.title: Secure Payment Integration
payments.desc: Payments securely processed via Paddle. No card data is stored on our servers.

renewal.title: Background Renewal
renewal.desc: Automatic subscription renewal via background processes. Retry logic on failed payments, status notifications.

core: Dedicated microservice per domain area (accounts, transactions, categories)
REST API with Pydantic v2 validation
automation: APScheduler for background jobs with configurable intervals
Idempotent job execution with retry policy
workspace: Row-level security via workspace_id filtering at ORM level
Invite tokens with TTL and single-use enforcement
intelligence: PDF parsing via dedicated microservice with tabula-py
REST API for goal tracking with milestone support
platform: Subscription lifecycle management via dedicated service
Plan-based feature enforcement at middleware level
Paddle payment gateway for secure payment processing

categories.title: Categories

goals.title: Financial Goals
goals.description: Create savings goals and track your progress. Whether it's a vacation, new gadget, or emergency fund — visualize your journey.

pdfParser.title: PDF Parser

workspaces.title: Workspaces

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how FinFlow ("we", "us", or "our"), operated by Individual Entrepreneur (FOP) Pavlenko Andrii Volodymyrovych (Tax ID: 3650600237), collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use the FinFlow platform available at https://finflow.ltd (the "Platform").

privacyPage.footer: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at finflow@flux-lab.dev

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.item1: Account Information: Name, email address, and password when you register an account.
dataCollection.item2: Financial Data: Transaction records, expense and income entries, budget goals, debt tracking information, and other financial data you enter into the Platform. This data is provided voluntarily by you and is not sourced from external financial institutions.
dataCollection.item3: Payment Information: When you subscribe to a paid plan, payment details are collected and processed by our payment provider, Paddle. We do not store your full card number on our servers. We only receive the last 4 digits of your card, card type, and expiration date for display purposes.
dataCollection.item4: Usage Data: Information about how you interact with the Platform, including pages visited, features used, device type, browser type, IP address, and session duration.
dataCollection.item5: Communications: Messages you send to us through the contact form or email.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.item1: To provide, maintain, and improve the Platform and its features.
dataUsage.item2: To process your subscription payments through Paddle.
dataUsage.item3: To send you account-related notifications, including billing reminders, subscription confirmations, and service updates.
dataUsage.item4: To respond to your support inquiries and feedback.
dataUsage.item5: To analyze usage patterns and improve Platform performance using aggregated, anonymized data.
dataUsage.item6: To comply with legal obligations under applicable law.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.item1: Paddle (Payment Processor): Paddle acts as our Merchant of Record and processes all payment transactions. When you make a purchase, Paddle collects your payment information directly. Paddle's handling of your data is governed by Paddle's Privacy Policy (https://www.paddle.com/legal/privacy).
thirdParty.item2: Google Analytics: We use Google Analytics to collect anonymized usage data about how visitors interact with the Platform. Google Analytics uses cookies to gather information such as pages visited, session duration, and device type. No personally identifiable financial data is shared with Google.
thirdParty.item3: Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or governmental authority.
thirdParty.item4: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.item1: All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted using TLS 1.2+ (HTTPS).
dataSecurity.item2: Payment processing is handled by Paddle, which is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant.
dataSecurity.item3: We do not store your full payment card details on our servers.
dataSecurity.item4: Access to user data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
dataSecurity.item5: While we take reasonable measures to protect your data, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.item1: Essential Cookies: Used to maintain your login session and ensure the Platform functions correctly. These are strictly necessary and cannot be disabled.
cookies.item2: Analytics Cookies: Used by Google Analytics to collect anonymized usage data. These help us understand how visitors use the Platform so we can improve it.
cookies.item3: You can manage or disable non-essential cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect Platform functionality.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.item1: Access the personal data we hold about you by contacting us.
userRights.item2: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data by updating your profile or contacting us.
userRights.item3: Delete your account and associated personal data by contacting us at finflow@flux-lab.dev. Upon account deletion, your personal data will be permanently removed within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
userRights.item4: Export your financial data from the Platform at any time.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.item1: Your account data and financial records are retained for as long as your account is active.
dataRetention.item2: After account deletion, personal data is permanently removed within 30 days, unless retention is required by applicable law.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy

changes.item2: For significant changes, we will notify you via email or through a notification on the Platform.
